request.description: Queues an analysis of the case (worker queue `analysis.run`): read the clean documents (all of them unless `documentIds` is given), then compute the financial health score with the published scoring model and fire improvement rules. Needs `ai_documents` consent. Only one analysis runs per application; asking again returns it. Poll `GET /analyses/:id` or listen for `analysis.changed`. Borrower and partner contexts; only applications the caller can see.

response.name: 202 Accepted
